title: Constructibility of a sheaf on the small etale site is a Zariski local property
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that constructibility of a sheaf on X_etale can be checked Zariski locally (statement lines 11788-11793). The proof is a short reduction with one non-formal step: for an affine open U one restricts the given open covering to U cap U_i, uses that restriction of a constructible sheaf to an open is constructible, and then invokes the same-chapter criterion producing a partition of U from constructible restrictions on a finite open covering (proof lines 11796-11804). The content is the reduction to the affine criterion, which is what makes the locality statement usable. The claim is H2: one reduction plus a cited criterion.
